feedback: If a child says the Sun goes around too, pause the game: the Sun stays in the middle while the planets travel round it
If a child lists the Sun among the planets, remind them the Sun is the star in the middle that gives light; the planets circle it and don't make their own light
activities.intendedInsight: Acting out orbiting is intended to make 'the Sun and the planets that go around it' something children feel in their bodies, reinforcing the meaning of 'solar system' and that the Sun sits in the middle with planets circling it.
learnerActions: Set up a central 'Sun' (a child, a lamp, or a marked spot) and have children walk in circles around it to act out 'the planets travel around the Sun'
Say the sentence as they move: 'the Sun stays in the middle while the planets go around it'
Point out that the Sun gives light while the planets do not make their own light — they are lit up by the Sun
Pause to 'find Earth' among the moving planets and confirm Earth is one of the ones going around
activities.title: Walk the orbit: become a planet going around the Sun
